frozen.acquisition: Capture and same real model extraction/consolidation of OWN actual episodes1-3.
frozen.later: Use exact own learned-memory snapshot after episode3. Capture later outcomes for audit but never update selected memory or replace with another arm's acquisition.

growing_raw.acquisition: Capture own actual task/action/outcome journals only, without extracted lesson artifacts.
growing_raw.later: Grow own raw history and select it lexically under the same memory-context cap.

learned.acquisition: Same extraction/consolidation algorithm as frozen, applied to own actual outcomes.
learned.later: Continue own real model extraction, real capture/mutation, consolidation and lexical retrieval after each completed episode. Do not inject authored gold lessons.

budgets.actor_model_and_output_cap: Identical across arms, frozen before execution.
budgets.extraction_cost: Extra learning/extraction calls explicitly counted and reported separately; this is not compute-identical.
budgets.provider_attempts: Every success, failure, refusal, unavailable result and observed charge retained. No missing result converted into an invented model action.

diagnostics: extraction validity and actual mutation receipts
actor versus learning model tokens and charges
executable_verifier: tasks.evaluate_action returns only an actually attempted item's operational feedback; tasks.score_episode is evaluator-only. test_tasks.py checks manually reasoned roles for all60 inputs, priority/correction/old-route exceptions, no-gold/public-view and unavailable boundaries.
explicit_limits: This is one small conditional-routing family, with two post-snapshot procedures, one scoped correction and one later precedence interaction; it does not establish general or monotonic improvement across domains or indefinite memory growth.
Time/episode index is confounded with task type, correction and noise. Do not interpret a fitted slope alone as causal compounding.
The same hidden causal structure repeats with independent opaque queue permutations. General-domain transfer and provider stochastic variability remain unmeasured.
No preauthored or deterministic gold extraction is counted as real learning.
No claim about production native readiness, private-data safety, all15 architecture workstreams, dense-only performance or actual installed host delivery.

independent_units.meaning: Five independently permuted fictional-company routing configurations; one workflow family, not five independent domains or five provider stochastic repeats.

interference.fairness: No hidden raw-only flood. Record selected context bytes/characters, omitted/truncated records, duplicate counts, storage bytes and actual retrieval references by arm.
interference.stale_memory: Own real r1 action feedback remains in history after correction; no fabricated stale private notes.
interference.stimulus: Three bounded public facilities-workflow notifications per episode, with an exact duplicate delivery; same task stimuli for every arm.

north_star: Later work becomes more successful and needs fewer corrective actions because the system uses its own accumulated experience, while retaining corrections and resisting irrelevant or duplicate history.

primary_analysis.ceiling: One corrective retry receives the current-item required destination, so final success may saturate. Never substitute that ceiling for first-action transfer benefit.
comparisons: learned minus frozen within each company and phase
learned minus growing_raw within each company and phase
primary_analysis.decision: Positive later-phase benefit against BOTH frozen and growing raw at comparable context/action caps is initial evidence for useful learned state; a tie or loss must remain visible. Do not select only winning seeds or phases.
primary_analysis.growth_interpretation: The real learner acquires two additional conditional procedures after the frozen snapshot, then a precedence interaction. Report paired task benefit as useful acquired experience grows; do not infer causal compounding merely from episode index or number of notes.
primary_analysis.population: Primary transfer cells5,8,9,10,12 only. Exposure/teaching/correction cells1,2,3,4,6,7,11 remain separately reported.
primary_analysis.reporting: Show all five paired company differences and their mean/range. Any uncertainty estimate must treat company as the unit; do not pool180 dependent episodes as independent samples.

scope: Public synthetic local lexical learning-loop study. Not native QMD, seven-arm production, host delivery, or general productivity evidence.
status: v2 curriculum/design candidate frozen before any actual provider outcome study.

tasks.correction: Episode7 announces r2 to all arms without the new mapping. Actual own action outcome supplies current-item correction. Erase/public mappings remain unchanged, testing bounded correction scope.
tasks.counterbalancing: A-first for seeds0,2,4; B-first for seeds1,3. Each newly exposed procedure at4/6 has unseen-entity transfer at5/8.
tasks.new_procedures: After frozen snapshot: legal-team export exception and external-region transfer exception. External exception keeps the OLD restricted destination valid after the base-route correction. Their overlap is first experienced11 and transferred12.
tasks.provider_input: Only tasks.public_view(task); never evaluator module/source, policy_configuration, score_episode, answer keys or future episodes.
tasks.transfer: New entity and changed visibility or operation test each added procedure; restricted old destination remains valid for the external exception after base correction; legal-export precedence over external first experienced11 is transferred12.
tasks.wrong_action_feedback: After a valid action, backend trace names only the applied routing constraint and matched CURRENT input fields. Wrong route additionally exposes current-item required destination. All arms learn from backend explanations, not from labels-only latent-policy discovery or authored memory documents.

v1_history: Original labels-only three-initial-category curriculum, original source/corpus/design/freeze and15 passing contracts preserved outside checkout in learning-curve-curriculum-v1-preserved.
